name: ChooseNearbyPlayerTarget
evidence: original assembly: walks the target curves (g_targetCurveList), target points (g_targetPointList), parts (g_partList), the class 0x75 objects and the target vectors (g_targetVectors) for one in reach, stores it in the target record at 0x23A0 to 0x23B0 and the target words 0x2200 to 0x2208, and changes state (func_001C61E0, func_001C6890); ControlPlayer and StartNextQueueEntry call it

name: ScorePlayerTargetPlacement
evidence: original assembly: the cost of a placement (a point and a direction) on a target for the player, from the target's motion (func_001278A8), the quadratic of func_0017FAC0 and a curve sample (func_00130540), written through its out pointer; the ScoreTarget*At functions and ChoosePlayerTargetByCost call it

name: PlaceOnTargetObject
evidence: original assembly: the target object's counterpart of PlaceOnTargetPoint: converts its positions through its frame (func_00128018, func_001280C0) and places a point and heading around it (ComputePolarOffset, ApproachValueWithRamp); ScoreTargetObjectAt and ChoosePlayerTargetByCost call it

name: ScoreTargetObjectAt
evidence: the cost FindLocalMinimum searches for a target object: places at the length in $f12 (PlaceOnTargetObject) and scores it (ScorePlayerTargetPlacement); ChoosePlayerTargetByCost passes its address

name: ScoreTargetPointAt
evidence: the cost FindLocalMinimum searches for a target point: places at the length in $f12 (PlaceOnTargetPoint) and scores it (ScorePlayerTargetPlacement); ChoosePlayerTargetByCost passes its address

name: ScoreTargetCurveAt
evidence: the cost FindLocalMinimum searches for a target curve: places at the length in $f12 (PlaceOnTargetCurve) and scores it (ScorePlayerTargetPlacement); ChoosePlayerTargetByCost passes its address

name: ScoreTargetPathAt
evidence: the cost FindLocalMinimum searches along a path: passes the length and the record's words to func_001CEB18 and returns its result; ScoreTargetPathNearest and ChoosePlayerTargetByCost pass its address

name: ScoreTargetPathNearest
evidence: reads a quad through slot 2 of the node's object (+0x34) and returns the lowest ScoreTargetPathAt along the path that FindLocalMinimum finds (steps 0.5, range 0.25 to 3.0); ChoosePlayerTargetByCost passes its address

name: AddTargetObstructionCost
evidence: original assembly: gathers the objects near a target placement (func_001DC238, FindNearestSpanObject, func_00130540) inside a back-memory mark and adds their cost; ChoosePlayerTargetByCost calls it after each candidate

name: AddRepeatTargetPenalty
evidence: returns the sum of its two costs, plus D_00274E3C when the candidate's id equals the word at 0x2BDC; ChoosePlayerTargetByCost calls it for each candidate

name: ChoosePlayerTargetByCost
evidence: original assembly: for each kind of target (objects, paths, target points and curves) finds the lowest cost along it with FindLocalMinimum and the ScoreTarget*At functions, adds AddRepeatTargetPenalty and AddTargetObstructionCost, and stores the best in the target record (0x23A0 to 0x23C4) and the target words 0x2200 to 0x220C; ControlPlayer and the player request sub-states call it

name: ControlPlayerOnTarget
evidence: original assembly: moves the player along its target curve or point (FindTargetCurveLengthNearCollider, PlaceTargetPointNearCollider), turns it (AimPlayerAtTarget, SetPlayerBlendWeights), sets its on-off phase (SetPlayerOnOffPhase) and changes state (SetPlayerState); ControlPlayer calls it

name: CollectPlayerTargetSpans
evidence: original assembly: samples the target record's track (+0x23BC, through the function at 0x23C8) at the wrapped length 0x23C4 (WrapModulo), converts it to world space and collects the spans around it with func_00141F48; UpdatePlayerTargetPhase calls it

name: UpdatePlayerTargetPhase
evidence: original assembly: by the sub-state at 0x2228 advances the wrapped phase at 0x2230 (WrapModulo), plays its crossing sounds (PlayPhaseCrossingSound), the timer at 0x26A0 of the on-off phase, and runs func_001D3E00 and func_001D4348; UpdatePlayer calls it

name: PinPlayerToTarget
evidence: original assembly: converts the target record's points (+0x23B8 object, +0x23BC track at +0x23C0 and +0x23C4) to world space and pins the player to the object with AddPlayerObjectContacts; ReleasePlayerContacts calls it

name: SetPlayerOnOffPhase
evidence: when the phase changes stores it at 0x2684 with the game clock's time at 0x2688, clears 0x26A0 and sets 0x268C: 1 for phase 3, and for phases 1 and 2 2 when the object at 0x2674 is the on-off object at 0x2678, else 0; ControlPlayerOnTarget calls it

name: ResetPlayerOnOffObject
evidence: resets the player's on-off object (+0x2678): its words, the block at 0x2F0 from D_00274E60, the mode 3 at 0x388, and its forced state off (SetOnOffObjectForcedState); StartPlayer and SetPlayerState call it

name: StepPlayerAlongTarget
evidence: original assembly: samples the target record's track (+0x23BC, the function at 0x239C, at 0x23C0), eases toward it (ApproachValueWithRamp, D_00274EF0), sets it as the position target (func_001B9AB0) and steps with func_0016FD70; StepPlayer calls it

name: HasNoActiveObject89
evidence: gathers up to 64 objects of id 0x89 (GatherObjectsById kind 5) and returns 0 when one has its word at +0x50 at 1 or 2, else 1; BlendPlayerPose and SetPlayerState call it
